statement: For a share option to be a qualifying Enterprise Management Incentives (EMI) option, notice of the option must be given to HMRC electronically on or before 6 July following the end of the tax year in which the option was granted, containing a declaration by a director or the secretary of the employer company that the Schedule 5 requirements are met and that the information is correct and complete.
caveat: The 6 July deadline is the text currently in force; options granted under earlier versions of paragraph 44 faced different timing. The scheme's qualifying conditions (gross assets, employee numbers, working time, excluded activities) are separate Schedule 5 requirements this rule does not state; a missed or defective notice costs the option its qualifying status.
